promises.quote: The Governing Governor is also committed to encouraging an environment in which all staff, including those who are not directly employed by HMPPS, feel able to raise concerns about an individual's management and will discuss with the Head of Healthcare how healthcare staff can be empowered to do so in accordance with Prison Service Instruction 16/2015 Adult Safeguarding in Prison.
promises.summary: Staff can raise concerns about individual management and will be empowered to do so.

promises.quote: We have also provided £1.6 billion of funding over two years to support the NHS and local authorities to ensure timely and effective discharge from hospital.
